research_scope: Future Saga Chapter 4 / final DLC skills introduced July 2026. Four paid-DLC moves were cross-checked against official DLC scope and current PQ/skill references. The Awoken Skill is documented separately from the three PQ-drop skills.

verification_audit.official_scope: Bandai Namco and platform listings confirm Future Saga Chapter 4 contains four new moves including one Awoken Skill, two Parallel Quests, and the two new playable characters Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) and Supreme Kai of Time (Ultra Supervillain).
verification_audit.acquisition_reconciliation: Current PQ185 and PQ186 reward guides identify Dragon Spiral and Indomitable on PQ185 and Venus Fist on PQ186. Independent 2026 acquisition documentation identifies all three as random PQ rewards. The Power to Overcome is a CaC Awoken Skill unlocked after completing the Chapter 4 story/final Extra Mission requirements.
verification_audit.probability_policy: No exact drop percentages are asserted. Community reports describe the three PQ skills as RNG drops, but those reports are not treated as numerical probability evidence.

records.name: Dragon Spiral
records.unlock_method: Random reward from Parallel Quest 185 — A God's Amusement or Parallel Quest 186 — Frieza's Right-Hand Man
records.skill_description: A Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled) Strike Super that advances through an aggressive sequence while interacting with the new Chapter 4 mechanics.
records.mechanics_notes: Current 2026 sources identify Dragon Spiral as one of the three non-Awoken Chapter 4 skills earned through the two new PQs. Exact hit count, damage scaling, and detailed timing should remain a separate mechanics-verification task until independently reconciled.
records.pve_notes: Acquisition is tied to the final DLC's two new PQs; exact drop conditions remain unresolved beyond the documented random-reward behavior.

records.name: Indomitable
records.unlock_method: Random reward from Parallel Quest 185 — A God's Amusement or Parallel Quest 186 — Frieza's Right-Hand Man
records.skill_description: A Chapter 4 charge/power-management skill associated with Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled).
records.mechanics_notes: Current 2026 acquisition sources identify Indomitable as the second non-Awoken Chapter 4 PQ skill. Its exact Ki/Stamina costs and detailed charge behavior are intentionally left unresolved here rather than inferred from unrelated skills with the same generic name.
records.pve_notes: The skill is obtained from the final DLC PQ reward pool; exact optimal use requires a dedicated mechanics pass.

records.name: Venus Fist
records.unlock_method: Random reward from Parallel Quest 185 — A God's Amusement or Parallel Quest 186 — Frieza's Right-Hand Man
records.skill_description: A Chapter 4 Strike Ultimate associated with Goku (Ultra Supervillain Quelled).
records.mechanics_notes: Current 2026 sources identify Venus Fist as the third non-Awoken Chapter 4 skill and place it in the PQ185/PQ186 random reward pool. Exact hit sequence, damage, and reward-slot semantics remain to be independently reconciled.
records.pve_notes: The skill is farmed from the final DLC PQs; community reports confirm players can receive it as an RNG reward but do not establish a numerical probability.

records.name: The Power to Overcome
records.unlock_method: Complete the Future Saga Chapter 4 story/final Extra Mission sequence after owning the DLC
records.source_quest_or_shop: Future Saga Chapter 4 story; final Extra Mission
records.skill_description: A two-stage universal CaC Awoken Skill. The initial form provides defensive/mobility benefits and a second activation enters an Unleashed/Overdrive state with temporary extremely rapid or effectively infinite Ki recovery while consuming health.
records.mechanics_notes: Official platform listings confirm Chapter 4 introduces one Awoken Skill. Independent 2026 testing sources identify the skill as The Power to Overcome and document a second-stage Unleashed/Overdrive mode, temporary rapid/infinite Ki availability, health consumption, and a cooldown between activations. Exact modifiers differ across community measurements, so this record intentionally avoids promoting conflicting numerical values as canonical.
records.combo_notes: The transformation changes the CaC grab behavior and provides a second activation state; exact interaction tables remain a future mechanics audit.
records.pve_notes: The temporary second stage changes resource management by trading health for extreme Ki availability.
records.pvp_notes: Exact competitive interactions and frame data remain version-sensitive and are not promoted here.
